assets.title: Harvested Pear Carrot and Cabbage Set
assets.description: Original editable harvested-food kit containing a shouldered pear with a thin stem, one complete tapered carrot with three folded leaves, and a rounded cabbage with three thick overlapping outer leaves. Each food uses a distinct continuous volume and named closed components, rather than recoloured sphere variants. Muted whole-food colours, no labels or external textures. Three foods count as one set ID. Static display placement only; no food preparation, growth, deformation or physical simulation.

assets.title: Ventilated Stackable Produce Crate
assets.description: Original single-specification .46 by .28 by .22 m open produce crate with a continuous closed shell, real ventilation holes, 110 by 43 mm end grip apertures, four outer corner landing pads and four lower inward locator tongues. Muted reusable-container material. Actual same-ID two-instance stacking and upright placement on the unchanged parcel handtruck are checked at documented poses. No load rating, dynamic transport, carrying stability, nesting or material-strength certification.
